sentences.en: I go to work every day.
She has a business in the town.
He works in an office.
The manager is in charge of the company.
A servant helps with work in the house.
The judge makes decisions in the court.
The writer makes books and stories.
A worker does physical work.
He is in the trade of selling cars.
I get money for my work.
Payment is made at the end of the month.
What is your work?
The manager gives orders to the workers.
I am a teacher. My work is at the school.
sentences.zh: 我是一名老师。我的工作在学校。

sentences.en: The porter helped with the bags at the station.
sentences.zh: 搬运工在车站帮忙搬行李。

sentences.en: I am in a position of responsibility at work.
sentences.zh: 我在工作中处于负责的职位。

sentences.en: The reward for the work was good.
The secretary wrote the notes for the meeting.
I join the company as a new worker.
sentences.zh: 我作为新员工加入公司。

sentences.en: The expert gave his opinion on the design.
sentences.zh: 专家对设计发表了他的意见。

sentences.en: The industry in this town makes metal parts.
sentences.zh: 这个镇的工业生产金属零件。
